references.text: The prohibition against turning to mediums and spiritists is mentioned here, forming the basis for the death penalty described in 20:27
God warns that He will turn against those who seek out mediums and spiritists, a point further elaborated with the death penalty in verse 27
Contains a list of forbidden occult practices, including mediumship, which is an abomination to the Lord
Saul had driven out the mediums from the land in accordance with the law, but later he himself sought out a medium at En-Dor
King Manasseh practiced mediumship and divination, which was among the sins that led to God's judgment
King Josiah eliminated mediums and spiritists as part of his religious reform, in accordance with the Mosaic Law
Saul's death is partly attributed to his seeking a medium instead of seeking the Lord
The prophet Isaiah warns against seeking the dead through mediums instead of seeking God
A witch shall not be allowed to live - a parallel law prescribing the death penalty for occult practices
Describes the procedure for stoning as an execution method, the same method mentioned in 20:27
